# Medium Trending Topics Finder (medium-trending-topics-finder)

> The official zero-telemetry, 100% local Chrome Extension for discovering trending Medium articles, high-performing topics, and engagement velocity.

## Key Facts
- **Software Type**: Google Chrome Extension (Manifest V3)
- **Extension Name**: Medium Trending Topics Finder
- **Repository Slug**: medium-trending-topics-finder
- **Primary Domain**: https://mediumradar.app
- **License**: MIT (Open Source)
- **Privacy Model**: 100% Local in-browser execution. Zero external API calls, zero tracking, zero remote data storage.
- **Compatibility**: All Chromium browsers (Google Chrome, Brave, Microsoft Edge, Arc, Opera, Vivaldi).

## Core Capabilities
1. **Real-time In-Page Analytics Overlay**: Injects a soft 3D claymorphic analytics dashboard directly into any Medium tag page (`medium.com/tag/*`) and the homepage feed.
2. **Engagement Scoring Algorithm**:
   - Formula: `Engagement Score = Claps + (Comments × 5)`
   - Rationale: High comments indicate deep reader resonance, controversy, debate, and genuine engagement beyond passive clapping.
3. **Automated Trend Badges**:
   - `💬 High Debate`: Stories with 30 or more comments/responses.
   - `🔥 Viral Claps`: Stories with 1,000 or more claps.
   - `⚡ Rising`: Stories with an Engagement Score >= 200.
   - `✨ Active`: Stories with steady reader momentum.
4. **Dynamic In-Feed Sorting**: Re-ranks stories on the fly by Engagement Score, Most Claps, or Most Comments.
5. **1-Click CSV Export**: Downloads structured reports containing Rank, Title, Claps, Comments, Engagement Score, Trend Signal, and Story URLs.
6. **Toolbar Popup**: Quick tag slug search bar, instant topic chips, and local offline scan history caching (`chrome.storage.local`).
